issues.detail: The Vietnamese translation omits the specific title 'architriklinō' (archpriest/chief priest), rendering it only as 'quan tọa' (official/judge), which loses the specific office mentioned in the Greek.
The Vietnamese 'Họ bèn đem' is grammatically incomplete and fails to capture the sense of 'hēnegkan' (they obeyed/did as they were told), which implies compliance with a command.
